title: ShellAtol's Phone
description: Adds a phone. The phone, when you right click it will open app menu.
body:
This datapack adds a new item: the Phone. This item, when right clicked, will open a menu with the apps Messages, Contacts, Music, and Camera. The music app plays sound c418 - cat, camera app takes a photo, contacts app shows you the online players, and messages app is like contacts but to message use msg command (vanilla command).
Dependency: [(REQUIRED) ShellAtol's Phone Resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/shellatols-phone-resource-pack/)

To craft it, surround a glass pane with 4 white concrete like:
